items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: And then after that he recorded the thing, if anybody had seen Miss Fanny Brown, when I was on that record.

ctx.x: Fanny Brown, if anybody had seen him as Fanny Brown. And where's my baseball bat? Mm-hm. And, oh, I forgot because it's been so long since I recorded it.
Were you in Roy Brown's band?
